title: Why India's half-built towers stand for years
text:
Buying under construction trades a lower entry price for completion risk, and that risk is larger than it looks from the brochure.
Anarock counted about 4.8 lakh homes stuck or badly delayed across the top 7 cities by May 2022, roughly half in NCR. In fully stalled projects, about two thirds of the units were already sold.
The common pattern: project loans sized for 3 to 4 years against delivery cycles of 7 to 8, then liquidity stress, litigation and insolvency. The SWAMIH fund (2019) had completed about 61,000 homes by Dec 2025.
Sources: Anarock via PTI, Liases Foras via Business Standard, Ministry of Finance.
How do you weigh completion risk when you assess an under-construction purchase?
